rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary: assented 23 March 2021; creates the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner, which registers controllers and processors and licenses data auditors; Data Protection (Registration and Licensing) Regulations are SI No. 58 of 2021.

rules.source: Data Protection Act, 2021 (Act No. 3 of 2021) — https://dataprotection.africa/?p=19767
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary: secondary sources report mandatory notification to the Commissioner within 24 hours of a security breach affecting personal data; exact section not verified from the Act text.

rules.source: Cyber Crimes Act No. 4 of 2025 — https://zambialii.org/akn/zm/act/2025/4
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary: signed 8 April 2025, repeals and replaces the Cyber Security and Cyber Crimes Act 2021; sets cybercrime offences, protection against cyber-enabled crimes and child online protection; ZambiaLII notes commencement 12 May 2025; ICNL says it criminalizes computer dissemination of false information damaging reputation.

rules.source: Cyber Security Act No. 3 of 2025 — https://zambialii.org/akn/zm/act/2025/3
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary (Bowmans): long title covers regulating security service providers and critical information infrastructure, establishing the Zambia Cyber Security Agency and registering critical information infrastructure; signed 8 April 2025.
